title: The Keeper and the Storm
logline: A solitary lighthouse keeper befriends a sentient storm, discovering that even the wildest forces can yearn for connection.
style_bible: A painterly, hand-crafted animation style reminiscent of watercolor and ink. The palette is moody: deep blues, grays, and muted golds, with splashes of electric blue for the storm. Soft, diffused lighting with dramatic chiaroscuro. The lighthouse beam cuts through mist. Textures are rough, like cold-pressed paper. Camera moves are slow and fluid, with occasional handheld shakiness during storm sequences. Era is timeless, early 20th-century maritime.

characters.name: Elias
characters.description: A sturdy lighthouse keeper in his 50s, with weathered skin, grey-streaked beard, and kind, deep-set eyes.
characters.wardrobe: Heavy oilskin coat over a wool sweater, trousers, boots, and a knitted cap.
characters.distinguishing_feature: A bright red scarf always around his neck.
characters.voice: Deep and gravelly, with a soft, warm tone.

characters.name: Tempest
characters.description: A sentient storm entity, a swirling mass of dark clouds, rain, and lightning, with two glowing electric-blue eyes.
characters.wardrobe: Its form is ever-shifting storm clouds and lightning; no garments.
characters.distinguishing_feature: Its piercing blue eyes that glow within the clouds.
characters.voice: A rumbling, echoing voice like distant thunder, capable of softening to a whisper.

shots.summary: The keeper lights the lighthouse lamp and spots the living storm on the horizon.
shots.location: Lighthouse lantern room and exterior view

timeline.action: {hero} trims the wick of the great lamp, his red scarf fluttering. Camera slowly dollies from wide shot to medium close-up on his hands.
He strikes a match, igniting the lamp; golden light spills across his face. Camera tilts up to capture the beam sweeping out to sea.
He peers through the rain-streaked window, spotting a distant swirling mass with faint blue glows. Camera pushes in on his eyes, then over-the-shoulder view of the storm.

shots.audio: Howling wind, distant thunder, creaking metal, a low cello note.

shots.summary: The storm rages around the lighthouse, and the keeper confronts it, discovering it is alive.

timeline.action: {hero} steps onto the gallery, gripping the railing as wind whips his coat. The {storm} looms closer, swirling with lightning. Camera shakes as if battered by wind, wide shot.
The {storm} forms a face-like vortex, its blue eyes glaring. {hero} stumbles but holds ground, shouting. Camera zooms in on storm's eyes, then low-angle on {hero}.
Lightning strikes the sea, illuminating {storm}'s tendrils reaching toward the lighthouse. {hero} raises a hand in greeting. Camera circles him, capturing storm's reflection in his eyes.

shots.summary: The keeper offers a small light to the storm, and they form a bond.

timeline.action: The {storm} retracts its tendrils, eyes softening. {hero} pulls out a small glowing lantern from his coat. Camera slowly zooms in on the lantern.
He holds the lantern high; the {storm} mimics, forming a spiral of clouds around the light. Camera pulls back to show both lights dancing together.
The {storm} speaks gently; {hero} smiles, tears mixing with rain. Camera does a slow 360-degree orbit around them, lighthouse beam cutting mist.

shots.audio: Wind dying, gentle rain, soft piano melody, distant thunder as lullaby.
